text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm taking a walk along
the river...
Hiyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash, dash, dash!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Who flies across the turf at light speed?!
El
Condor Pasaaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I chase the wind and then leave it in the
dust! This
is the spectacular velocity of a
champion!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Así es! Were you captivated by my
running just
now?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course you were. I am the world's
mightiest
fighter, after all!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm always fortifying myself so that I can
take on
any challenger!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pues claro! Now, to return to my
passionate
sprint.
choice_data_list_en: You're really giving it your all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riiip!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Ugh...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Estoy bien, I'm good...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I don't seem to have twisted anything,
but my
shoes are now ruined.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Could this be Grass's wrath?! I'm innocent, I swear!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know. It's just a joke I like to make,
since I trip
quite often.
choice_data_list_en: I don't think that has anything to do with it, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Welp! Guess it's time to induct these
shoes into
the shrine of late greats!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Curious to know more? Then
follow me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa leads me to an
inconspicuous spot
behind the academy
building.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at that box over there and
read
what's written on it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
This is where I lay to rest all the shoes
that have
accompanied me through my
historic training
routines.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This shrine commemorates
all the
brave luchadores of times past!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tucked away in this hidden corner of the

academy grounds is her box filled to the
brim with
shoes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You fulfilled your duty honorably... Now,
may you
rest here in peace.
choice_data_list: 全部破れたり壊れたりしてる……

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...There we go.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I will never forget
the way
you supported my feet.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
During days of sunshine and days of rain.
On turf,
dirt... and through all the four
seasons.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We went through so much together. And
you
taught me many new lessons.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And although your time here has ended,
my
journey continues on. So please,
watch over me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
De acuerdo! I'm sure all my late
luchadores will be
overjoyed!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My history is filled with countless
shoes—heroes
that have tread this path
alongside me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to spread my wings and show
the world
that I'm the strongest
Umamusume ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every time El Condor Pasa is about to
twist an
ankle, her shoes are there to
protect her. But
more than that, they
form an integral part of her
running.
